exceptions.rationale: This stateless OAuth2 resource server accepts Authorization bearer tokens and no browser session cookie; browsers do not attach bearer tokens automatically, so CSRF is not the applicable control. Re-reviewed 2026-10-12: The added staff and review routes require SCOPE_account; the stateless bearer chain remains unchanged, with no browser cookie authentication. Role checks remain service-owned. Fresh hosted CodeQL analysis remains required. DLV-930: reviewed explicit account-scoped POST invitation activation; bearer-only boundary unchanged. GET no longer claims invitations. Expiry unchanged. DLV-209 reviewed membership routes: public GET catalog only; purchases and staff writes retain bearer scopes and Gateway session CSRF. Role enforcement remains in the Domain service. Expiry unchanged. DLV-961 review 2026-10-16: added access-summary and managed test-account matchers still require SCOPE_account in the stateless bearer-only chain. No cookie, Basic or form authentication added; staff/reset ownership remains service-enforced. Exact rule/file and expiry unchanged.

DEV/PROD internal Gateway admission is a stateless server-to-server bearer resource chain; it accepts no session-cookie, HTTP Basic or form authentication. Every admission requires a decoded and Cognito-verified access token plus a constant-time comparison with the server-configured Gateway secret. Browser session CSRF remains enforced by Gateway. CloudAdmissionSecurityTest covers cookie-only and missing credential denial in both profiles.
